White Chess Bishop Symbol

There is no legacy Windows Alt code for White Chess Bishop because it is not in either the OEM code page 437 or Windows-1252 tables. The Unicode codepoint is U+2657, which you can use as ♗ in HTML, \2657 in CSS, or type with Alt+9815 on Windows (BMP only). If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly. White Chess Bishop is outside both legacy code pages, which is why U+2657 is the identifier that works across Word, HTML, CSS, Python and JavaScript. White Chess Bishop has no named HTML entity, so use the numeric escape ♗ or the hex escape ♗.

How to type white chess bishop on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 9 8 1 5 on the numeric keypad for the decimal codepoint 9815.
  4. Release Alt. The White Chess Bishop character (♗) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type white chess bishop on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for White Chess Bishop. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "White Chess Bishop" and click the character to insert it.

How to use white chess bishop in code

  • HTML: or
  • CSS: content:"\2657"; ()
  • Python: \u2657 or chr(0x2657)
  • JavaScript: \u2657 or String.fromCodePoint(0x2657)
  • JSON: "\u2657"

Frequently asked questions

Is there an Alt code for ♗?

No legacy Alt code exists for White Chess Bishop because it is not in code page 437 or Windows-1252. Use the Unicode codepoint U+2657 in HTML, CSS or the Character Viewer instead.

How do I type ♗ without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as ♗, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+9815 not work?

Alt+9815 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for White Chess Bishop?

The Unicode codepoint for White Chess Bishop is U+2657. You can use this value in HTML as ♗, in CSS as \2657, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type ♗ on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+2657, then click it.
